Kalki Jayanti 2026: Auspicious Date, Rituals, and Significance

Kalki Jayanti in 2026 will be observed on August 31st. The day is linked to Lord Vishnu's tenth avatar, Kalki. Coverage details the auspicious timings (muhurat) for puja and the correct rituals for performing the worship at home. It also touches upon the mythological stories associated with the day and the significance of observing the fast, including offering prayers to Lord Shiva and Parvati and the moon.
